name: Setup Docker Builder
description: Sets up a Docker buildkitd builder with sticky disk cache for improved build performance

platforms.description: List of target platforms for build (e.g., linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7)

nofallback.description: If true, fail the action if Blacksmith builder setup fails instead of falling back to local builder

github-token.description: GitHub token for GitHub API access

buildkit-version.description: BuildKit version to install (e.g., v0.16.0, v0.18.0). If not specified, uses system default

skip-integrity-check.description: If true, skip the bbolt database integrity check

driver-opts.description: List of additional driver-specific options (e.g., env.VARIABLE=value)

max-parallelism.description: Maximum number of concurrent BuildKit RUN steps. Defaults to the number of vCPUs on the runner.

max-cache-size-mb.description: Amount of build cache to retain after pruning, in MB (e.g., 409600 for 400GB). If not set, pruning is skipped.
